title: Verb 'to be' (am/is/are) / Verbụ 'ịmụ' (am/is/are)
bridge: N'igbo, anyị nwere ọtụtụ ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro. N'igbo, anyị nwere ọtụtụ ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro. N'igbo, anyị nwere ọtụtụ ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro. N'igbo, anyị nwere ọtụtụ ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro nke ndoro ndoro.
rule: Verbụ 'ịmụ' n'ụbọchị nwere ọnọdụ atọ: 'am' (na-egosi 'I'), 'is' (na-egosi 'he, she, it') na 'are' (na-egosi 'you, we, they'). Iji mepụta ajụjụ, ọ ga-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro: 'Are you...?', 'Is he...?'. Iji zeghe, ọ ga-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro: 'I am not', 'he is not' (ma ọ bụ 'he isn't'), 'they are not' (ma ọ bụ 'they aren't').

concept_examples.translation: Ọ dị m ike? (n'okwu ndoro: Ọ nwere ike ọma?)

common_error.explanation: N'igbo, anyị na-akwụ ọnọdụ 'A mụ onye nkuzi' n'okpuru ndoro ndoro, mana n'igbo, verbụ 'ịmụ' bụ ndoro ndoro. Maka ndoro, ndoro ndoro 'am/is/are'.

examples.note: Anyị na-egosi 'is' n'ime otu onye nwere ike ọma.
Nke a na-akpọ 'aren't' bụ ndoro ndoro n'ime okwu ndoro.

examples.translation: Ọ nwere ike ọma na ndị a nwere ike?
examples.note: Anyị na-eme ka ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro.

title: Personal Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they) / Pronouns Personal (M, gị, ọ, ya, ọ, anyị, ha)
bridge: N'igbo, ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro: m, gị, ọ, ya, ọ, anyị, ha. Nke ukwuu bụ na n'igbo, anyị na-egosi ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro n'ime otu asusu, mana n'igbo, anyị na-egosi ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro n'ime otu asusu. 'M na-eme mma' (a na-egosi mma). N'igbo, 'ọ' bụ ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro, mana n'igbo, ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-egosi ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro.
rule: Ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro n'igbo bụ: m (I), gị (you), ọ (he/she/it), anyị (we), ha (they). 'Ọ' bụ ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro n'ime ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro. 'Gị' bụ ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-egosi ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro. N'igbo, ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-egosi ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro n'ime otu asusu.

concept_examples.translation: Anyị bụ ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro.

common_error.correct: He is a teacher. / She is a teacher.
common_error.explanation: N'igbo, anyị na-egosi 'Ọ bụ onye nkiri' n'ime otu asusu, mana n'igbo, ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro na-egosi ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro. Anyị ga-eme ka 'Ọ bụ...' ma ọ bụ 'Ya bụ...'.

title: Articles (a/an, the)
bridge: N'igbo na-akwado ndepụta: 'a/an' (ndepụta ndoro) na 'the' (ndepụta ndoro). Ndoro nke ahu bụ na igbo adịghị eme ka 'the' nwere ike iji tụọrọ ihe ndoro (a na-akwado 'Life is beautiful', ma ọ bụghị 'The life is beautiful'). N'ihi na na-akwado ndoro nwere ike iji tụọrọ ihe ndoro n'igbo, tụọrọ 'I am a teacher' (n'igbo a na-akwado 'Soy profesor' ma ọ bụghị ndepụta).
rule: A na-akwado 'a' n'okpuru okwu ndoro na-egosi otu ihe na-egosi otu ihe na-egosi otu ihe na-egosi otu ihe na-egosi otu ihe. A na-akwado 'an' n'okpuru okwu ndoro na-egosi otu ihe na-egosi otu ihe na-egosi otu ihe na-egosi otu ihe. A na-akwado 'the' iji tụọrọ ihe ndoro ma ọ bụ tụọrọ ihe ndoro ma ọ bụ tụọrọ ihe ndoro. A na-akwado 'the' iji tụọrọ ihe ndoro ma ọ bụ tụọrọ ihe ndoro.

common_error.explanation: N'igbo, a na-akwado 'Soy profesor' ma ọ bụghị ndepụta. N'igbo, tụọrọ ndoro nwere ike iji tụọrọ ihe ndoro ma ọ bụ tụọrọ ihe ndoro.

examples.note: A na-akwado 'a' n'okpuru okwu ndoro na-egosi otu ihe na-egosi otu ihe.
A na-akwado 'an' n'okpuru okwu ndoro na-egosi otu ihe na-egosi otu ihe.
'The' na-akwado iji tụọrọ ihe ndoro ma ọ bụ tụọrọ ihe ndoro.
Iji tụọrọ ihe ndoro, a na-akwado 'the' ma ọ bụghị.
